babytv.uk.description: Baby and Sheep want to go for a swim in the lake but Sheep can't find her orange bathing suit. Join Baby & Sheep as they search for everything orange. S1 Ep20

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune. S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam play I Spy when Bambam spots a frog! That's when the fun begins as they hop and jump around like frogs.

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam go cherry picking. One of the cherries rolls down the hill straight into an anthill.

babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become hairdressers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles shampoo! A red-head puppy needs a haircut!

babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mountaineers! Climb the high mountain, paint fluffy clouds and tickle the sky way up high! S1 Ep17

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become detectives! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magnifying glass! S1 Ep29

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a field mouse in a wheat field! Mouse prepares wheat grain for his visiting cousin, the city mouse.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Skunk has an unpleasant smell and no one wants to be his friend! His smell protects him from enemies!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Can you whistle? Join Mr. Snail as he looks for guinea pig - the champion whistler! Learn how to whistle like a guinea pig!

babytv.uk.description: Join Captain Katie, Jon Jon, Beth and their faithful monkey Ari as they set sail on an adventure to find the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets wonderful warblers in a thicket! Come along and play hide and seek with Mr. Snail and the warblers!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Who's making that munching sound? Join Mr. Snail as he meets a happy hamster! Discover that hamster stores food in his cheeks!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a friendly fly and rabbit! The carrot is stuck in the ground! Join Mr. Snail as he tries to help!

babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the world of the Vikings.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the colorful world of the Vikings.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu find themselves in a magical amusement park where they ride on roller coasters, merry go rounds and more. S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Perry wants to play with Harley but Harley keeps falling asleep. Will Perry manage to wake her up?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Yay! It's a sunny day at the beach for Pix and Leo. Oh, but who is sneaking behind the tree and squirting water on them? Hmmm... Who could it be?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli meets HJ the elephant and learns all about what his trunk can do! He drinks with it, sprays water, searches high and low.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: When Bucky hears about the exciting travels of a bird who is migrating south for the winter, he doesn't want to miss out on all the excitement.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: When a caterpillar comes to visit the island, things get a little out of hand as Lily accidentally throws him off her after a fit of laughter.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's Christmas on the island, and Coco is preparing for his special carol singing. But every time Coco starts singing, a guest arrives.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Switzerland. The cuckoo bird wakes Claude and Francesca!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Hungary. King Franz loves the Danube River! One morning, the river turns muddy brown!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Canada. The friends want to eat pancakes but have no peanut butter!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become traffic officers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a whistle!

babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become artists! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a paintbrush and easel! S1 Ep19

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam find a mouse in their tree house. When he disappears, they decide to play mouse race!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam have toy robots! When their batteries run out Billy and Bambam use cardboard boxes to become robots themselves!

babytv.uk.description: Ready to run, jump, hop turn around and touch the ground? Then get yourself a rabbit and come join me!

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Parental Guidance

freeform.us.title: Mulan
freeform.us.description: Fearful that her ailing father will be drafted into the Chinese military, Mulan takes his spot -- though, as a girl living under a patriarchal regime, she is technically unqualified to serve. She cleverly impersonates a man and goes off to train with fellow recruits. Accompanied by her dragon, Mushu, she uses her smarts to help ward off a Hun invasion, falling in love with a dashing captain along the way. (Animated, Children, Musical) - 1998

freeform.us.title: Aladdin
freeform.us.description: When street rat Aladdin frees a genie from a lamp, he finds his wishes granted. However, he soon finds that the evil has other plans for the lamp -- and for Princess Jasmine. But can Aladdin save Princess Jasmine and his love for her after she sees that he isn't quite what he appears to be? (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

freeform.us.title: The Little Mermaid
freeform.us.description: In Disney's beguiling animated romp, rebellious 16-year-old mermaid Ariel (Jodi Benson) is fascinated with life on land. On one of her visits to the surface, which are forbidden by her controlling father, King Triton, she falls for a human prince. Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. But when plans go awry for the star-crossed lovers, the king must make the ultimate sacrifice for his daughter. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1989

freeform.us.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
freeform.us.description: An animated Disney adventure follows disfigured Quasimodo (Tom Hulce), the bell-ringer of Notre Dame Cathedral, who bides his time locked away in a tower. With only gargoyles to keep him company, Quasimodo longs to be with other people, leading to his chance encounter with the enchanting Gypsy Esmeralda (Demi Moore). When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches. (Animated, Children, Drama) - 1996

freeform.us.title: The Princess Diaries
freeform.us.description: Shy San Francisco teenager Mia Thermopolis (Anne Hathaway) is thrown for a loop when, from out of the blue, she learns the astonishing news that she's a real-life princess! As the heir apparent to the crown of the small European principality of Genovia, Mia begins a comical journey toward the throne when her strict and formidable grandmother, Queen Clarisse Renaldi (Julie Andrews), shows up to give her "princess lessons." (Children, Comedy) - 2001

freeform.us.title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
freeform.us.description: Mia (Anne Hathaway), still coming to terms with her life as a princess, graduates from Princeton. She returns to Genovia, and her best friend, Lilly (Heather Matarazzo), goes with her. When they arrive, Mia's grandmother (Julie Andrews) informs her that Mia cannot become queen unless she is married within 30 days. Nicholas Devereaux (Chris Pine) is one of her top suitors, though he is more interested in the crown than Mia. But when Nicholas realizes he loves Mia, he decides not to pursue her. (Children, Romantic comedy) - 2004

freeform.us.title: Finding Nemo
freeform.us.description: Marlin (Albert Brooks), a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo (Alexander Gould), who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver, and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2003

freeform.us.title: Finding Dory
freeform.us.description: Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) is a wide-eyed, blue tang fish who suffers from memory loss every 10 seconds or so. The one thing she can remember is that she somehow became separated from her parents as a child. With help from her friends Nemo and Marlin, Dory embarks on an epic adventure to find them. Her journey brings her to the Marine Life Institute, a conservatory that houses diverse ocean species. Dory now knows that her family reunion will only happen if she can save mom and dad from captivity. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

gritxtra.us.title: The Missing
gritxtra.us.description: When rancher and single mother of two Maggie Gilkeson (Cate Blanchett) sees her teenage daughter, Lilly (Evan Rachel Wood), kidnapped by Apache rebels, she reluctantly accepts the help of her estranged father, Samuel (Tommy Lee Jones), in tracking down the kidnappers. Along the way, the two must learn to reconcile the past and work together if they are going to have any hope of getting Lilly back before she is taken over the border and forced to become a prostitute. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller, Western) - 2003-11-19

gritxtra.us.title: There Will Be Blood
gritxtra.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama, Movie) - 2007-09-27

gritxtra.us.title: The Virginian
gritxtra.us.description: Determined to carve out a life on the new frontier, the Virginian (Bill Pullman) heads west to Wyoming. He signs on as foreman of a cattle ranch and begins romancing Molly Stark (Diane Lane), a quiet but pretty schoolteacher who's also from the east. An old rivalry rears its head in the form of Trampas (Colm Feore), a former friend who betrayed the Virginian. Another rancher begins a feud, and the Virginian must defend his honor while still hoping to gain Molly's approval. (Movie, TV Movie, Western) - 2000-01-09

gritxtra.us.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
gritxtra.us.description: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron. (Action, Comedy, Movie, Western) - 2023-09-15

gritxtra.us.title: Trail Street
gritxtra.us.description: Legendary lawman Bat Masterson (Randolph Scott) is called to rural Kansas to defend farmers from ruthless cattlemen. Joining Masterson in his efforts to clean up a lawless town are a couple of locals: Masterson's old chum Billy Burn and landowner Allen Harper (Robert Ryan). But ranch owner Logan Maury proves to be a more than formidable opponent. He'll stop at nothing, including murder, to turn the farmers' fields into grazing grounds for his cattle. (Movie, Western) - 1947

gritxtra.us.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
gritxtra.us.description: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive. (Movie, Western) - 1958-08-06

gritxtra.us.title: High Plains Drifter

When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda. (Movie, Western) - 1973-04-19

gritxtra.us.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
gritxtra.us.description: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Western) - 1970

gritxtra.us.title: Joe Kidd

In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch. (Movie, Western) - 1972-10-21

Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway. (Movie, Western) - 1952-06-13

gritxtra.us.title: Hangman's Knot

After capturing a coach driven by nurse Molly Hull (Donna Reed), the soldiers try to evade a group of bandits chasing them to steal the gold. (Movie, Western) - 1952-11-15

magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team travels to a secluded piece of land close to Desert Pond to help a couple turn their shack into a relaxing retreat; the couple has big plans, which means the crew will be stretched with a $30,000 budget and four weeks to finish the project.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Updating at Lincolnville Lakeview
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A family enlists Chase and the team to update their 30-year-old cabin, bunkhouse and boat house in Lincolnville, Maine; the team faces surprises around every corner as they race to finish the renovations in time for the family to enjoy the summer.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Heirloom Home on the Shore
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Builder Chase Morrill and his team tackle a family camp on the coast of the New Meadows River in West Bath, Maine; the third-generation owners have decided to add more appropriate living quarters for the large family reunions they host each year.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Roanoke Chamber of Commerce
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The crew salvages items from the chamber of commerce building in Roanoke, Va., including safe deposit boxes and a pneumatic messaging system; the team works on a large bar commissioned for the Natural Bridge Historic Hotel in Natural Bridge, Va.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - St. Michael's Catholic School
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team heads to the St. Michael's Catholic School in Pittsburgh, where they brave great heights in order to save elements from the past; the team also builds a ladder console and discovers a vintage army record player.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Greek Revival Farmhouse
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team preserves a Greek Revival farmhouse in Bentleyville, Pa., salvaging mantles, tiles and a full-sized chicken coop; Mike and Tay build a freight cart couch; Robert gets excited about a corn sheller.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Vaughan Furniture Company
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team heads to the Vaughan Furniture Company in Galax, Va.; Mike and Ted struggle to salvage a heavy furniture press, while Robert is slowed down by explosion-proof lights. Mike and Grayson build a chair with pieces from an old suitcase.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Second Chance Stage - Country and a Classical Twist
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A grocer, client specialist, rancher, financial planner and teacher take the stage for their chance to achieve their long-delayed dreams.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Put to the Test
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Mark and the guys make the seven-hour trek to Dubois, Ind., to salvage a cabin picked by the youngest member of the crew, Evan; it's a big step to prove that his apprenticeship days are over.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Appalachian Ancestry
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The Barnwood Builders team travels to Berea, Ky., to save an incredible log cabin built in 1795; as they peel away layer after layer of siding they discover a hand hewn masterpiece of Appalachian craftsmanship.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Bricks and Beams
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Mark Bowe and the Barnwood Builders crew build a beautiful, two-story log cabin addition for an old brick home in the rolling hills outside Lexington, Va.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Big Time Timberframe
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Mark and the guys travel to Patrick, S.C., to build a huge wedding pavilion, the biggest timber frame they've ever created; on a job this big, they need some extra help so they bring along Mark's latest hire and have fun teaching the new kid.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Secrets From the Boneyard
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The Barnwood Builders return to the Boneyard to do the work most folks never get to see; they turn a Kentucky two-story log cabin into a double pen dogtrot and repair a beautiful timber frame barn from Pennsylvania.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - Small Town, Big Dreams
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: White Sulphur Springs, W.V., is a small town with big plans after a tragic flood devastates the community; the Barnwood Builders play a big part in this small town's revival as they build a log cabin and timber frame.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Coastal Cottage in Hampton, Virginia
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A couple that dreams of raising their two sons along the shores of Hampton, Va. finds a waterfront property in need of serious updating.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - Revamp on the Outer Banks
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A family of avid beach-goers has outgrown their home on the Outer Banks of North Carolina and is looking for a home with more space that they can make renovations on themselves.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation - A Forever Home in Isle of Palms
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A woman is looking for a home in Isle of Palms, S.C., that is close to the beach and has enough space for family and friends; she finds a home that could be perfect, but it needs a lot of work, so she sets out to turn her dream into a reality.

mgmplus.us.title: Double Impact
mgmplus.us.description: Nearly 25 years after seeing his father killed by Hong Kong crime boss Raymond Zhang (Philip Chan Yan Kin), Chad Wagner (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is living in Los Angeles as a flourishing yet peaceful martial arts trainer. But Chad has a twin brother, Alex (also Van Damme), who suddenly reunites with his less-aggressive sibling and wants to avenge their father's death. As the pair plan their payback against Zhang, they also struggle to overcome their personal differences. (Action, Drama) - 1991

mgmplus.us.title: The Alamo
mgmplus.us.description: In 1836, the Mexican army, led by General Santa Anna, is invading Texas. Hoping to create a diversion for Santa Anna's forces, General Sam Houston (Richard Boone) orders Colonel William B. Travis (Laurence Harvey), joined by Colonels Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and Davy Crockett (John Wayne), to lead a small, heroic band of American and Texican fighters in a resistance battle at the Alamo mission. The carnage at the Alamo further spurs the Republic of Texas toward freedom. (Historical drama, War, Western) - 1960

mgmplus.us.title: Overboard
mgmplus.us.description: Snobbish and wealthy Joanna Stayton is living a life of leisure with her husband, Grant, when she falls off their yacht and suffers amnesia. Grant takes the opportunity to rid himself of the demanding Joanna -- but Dean, a widowed carpenter with four kids who once worked for Joanna, arrives and claims she's his wife. Joanna can't remember her past identity, but has trouble believing that she was ever meant to be a working-class mother of four. (Comedy, Romance) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: A Fish Called Wanda
mgmplus.us.description: British gangster George Thomason (Tom Georgeson) and his hapless aide, Ken Pile (Michael Palin), draft a pair of arrogant Americans, grifter Wanda Gerschwitz (Jamie Lee Curtis) and weapons expert Otto West (Kevin Kline), for a massive diamond heist. When the job goes badly, Wanda attempts to seduce George's stuffy lawyer, Archie Leach (John Cleese), to find out where George hid the diamonds. Meanwhile, Ken repeatedly attempts to kill an elderly woman (Patricia Hayes) who witnessed the robbery. (Comedy) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Back to School
mgmplus.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: Barbershop
mgmplus.us.description: A smart comedy about a day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin (Ice Cube), who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. nicktoons.uk.description: Pat The Hapless goes on a barbaric quest to the shopping mall in 'Chopping Spree', then in 'All Bot Myself', after Captain Quasar buys a new robot, Pat-Tron works for the Star family. (S3, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: The campers meet two backwoods narwhals in 'Sugar Squeeze', then in 'Tag, You're It', On a rainy day, SpongeBob and his friends entertain themselves indoors with a turbulent game of tag. (S1, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie. (S2, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton recruits Sandy to help in his lab in 'Mad Science Squirrel', then in 'To Pop a Bubble', SpongeBob's new friend proves unpopular at camp. (S2, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: In 'Bubblestand' SpongeBob introduces his friends to the art of bubble blowing, and in 'Ripped Pants' SpongeBob tries to impress Sandy at Mussel Beach. (S1, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob shrinks the whole of Bikini Bottom in 'Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy IV', and then in 'Doing Time', Mrs. Puff is sent to prison when SpongeBob crashes his boat.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help. (S1, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob's favourite jellyfishing net goes missing in 'The Pink Purloiner', and then in 'Squid Wood', SpongeBob decides that if he can't hang around with the real Squidward, he'll make his own.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs is messing up Pearl's preparations in 'The Slumber Party', and then in 'Grooming Gary', SpongeBob gives Gary a makeover, so that he can enter him in a pet show. But Gary's not so keen.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: The show finds an adorable new star in 'Patty-Poo', then in 'Swaptoberfest', the Star family swap identities. (S3, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick ventures inside Cecil to learn how the body works in 'To Dad and Back', then in 'Survivoring', Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV. (S1, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: The Great Patty Caper: SpongeBob, Patrick and Plankton solve a mystery on a runaway train.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral

screenpix.us.title: Crime of Passion
screenpix.us.description: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Cloudburst
screenpix.us.description: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief? (Mystery) - 1951

screenpix.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpix.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1944

screenpix.us.title: The Mugger
screenpix.us.description: A police psychiatrist lends his expertise to the hunt for a purse snatcher who leaves his victims with a facial scar. (Crime drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The Secret of Santa Vittoria
screenpix.us.description: In Santa Vittoria, an Italian town renowned for its vineyards, the residents discover that the occupying Nazi troops plan to take all their wine for themselves. Determined to keep as many bottles as they can, the citizens, led by Mayor Italo Bombolini (Anthony Quinn), try to appease the Germans by offering them a generous number of cases and hiding the rest. Unfortunately, the Nazi leader, Captain Von Prum (Hardy Kruger), realizes that there is more wine, and becomes intent on finding it. (Comedy) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: What's New, Pussycat?
screenpix.us.description: An irrepressible cad by nature, Michael James (Peter O'Toole) is determined to reform and stay faithful to his fiancée, Carole (Romy Schneider). However, Michael's attempt at fidelity is jeopardized when numerous attractive women become smitten with him, including Liz (Paula Prentiss) and Rita (Ursula Andress). Meanwhile, another of Michael's admirers, Renée (Capucine), is the object of fixation for his therapist, the wacky Dr. Fritz Fassbender (Peter Sellers). (Comedy) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: The Missing Lady

screenpix.us.title: Inherit the Wind

Drawing intense national attention in the media with writer E. K. Hornbeck (Gene Kelly) reporting, two of the nation's leading lawyers go head-to-head: Matthew Harrison Brady (Fredric March) for the prosecution, and Henry Drummond (Spencer Tracy) for the defense. (Drama) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Bloody Mama
screenpixaction.us.description: Sexually abused as a young girl, Kate "Ma" Barker (Shelley Winters) grows into a violently powerful woman by the 1930s. She lovingly dominates her grown sons, and grooms them into a pack of tough crooks. The boys include the cruel Herman (Don Stroud), who still shares a bed with Ma; Fred (Robert Walden), an ex-con who fell in love with a fellow prisoner; and Lloyd (Robert De Niro), who gets high on whatever's handy. Together they form a deadly, bizarre family of Depression-era bandits. (Crime drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: Cooley High
screenpixvoices.us.description: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry. (Comedy drama) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
screenpixvoices.us.description: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center. (Musical) - 1984

screenpixvoices.us.title: Rappin'
screenpixvoices.us.description: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music. (Musical, Drama) - 1985

screenpixvoices.us.title: Beat Street
screenpixvoices.us.description: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams. (Musical, Drama) - 1984

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hurricane Streets
screenpixvoices.us.description: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico. (Drama) - 1997

screenpixvoices.us.title: Crack House
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her. (Crime drama) - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: Original Gangstas
screenpixvoices.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: Feast of Love
screenpixvoices.us.description: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tomahawk Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Cavalry veteran Sgt. Wade McCoy immediately butts heads with his new supervisor, Lt. Jonathan Davenport, over the latter's lack of experience on the treacherous route known as the "Tomahawk Trail," but Davenport's unfamiliarity with the territory proves deadly when a trip to Fort Bowie finds the troop under Apache attack. Crazy from the heat, Davenport turns on his men, forcing McCoy to go against his commanding officer in order to save the lives of others. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Captain John Smith and Pocahontas
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Back in England after his trip to Jamestown, Va., Capt. John Smith (Anthony Dexter) tells the tale of his journey, particularly his lost romance with Native American maiden Pocahontas (Jody Lawrence). They meet and gradually fall for each other when captured Smith is saved from certain death by the girl. But as Smith tries to maintain peace between the British colonists and local tribes, the task proves harrowing, and Smith's friend Rolfe (Robert Clarke) begins to move in on Pocahontas. (Historical drama) - 1953

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Grayeagle
screenpixwesterns.us.description: One day while reputable trapper John Colter (Ben Johnson) is away from home, his adoring daughter Beth (Lana Wood) is captured by the notorious Indian Grayeagle (Alex Cord). But, as her father begins his tireless search to recover her, Beth is surprised to discover that there is more to Grayeagle than his fearsome reputation would imply. As she grows to realize that he is a man of honor -- much like her father -- she begins to fall in love with this proud Cheyenne warrior. (Western) - 1977

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Yellow Tomahawk
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After commanding the brutal slaughter of a Cheyenne tribe, callous cavalry leader Maj. Ives (Warner Anderson) then orders the construction of a military base on Native American territory. While the surviving Cheyenne men plot their revenge, warrior Fireknife (Lee Van Cleef) contacts his friend cavalry scout Adam Reed (Rory Calhoun), and warns him of the bloodbath that will occur if Ives doesn't retreat from the area. Reed passes on the message, which falls on deaf ears, and chaos ensues. (Western) - 1954

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Iroquois Trail
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War. (Western) - 1950

screenpixwesterns.us.title: War Drums
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether to return when war with the Apaches erupts. (Western) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Kentuckian
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Upstanding widower "Big Eli" Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) decides to move from Kentucky further west to Texas. He undertakes the journey with just his young son "Little Eli" (Donald MacDonald), but en route they pick up friends like indentured servant Hannah (Dianne Foster) and schoolmarm Susie (Diana Lynn), a potential love interest. This motley crew's path is difficult, and they face many obstacles, not the least of which is nasty frontiersman Stan Bodine (Walter Matthau). (Western, Drama) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: High, Wild and Free
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Filmmaker Gordon Eastman's chronicle of a summer spent exploring the natural wonders of British Columbia. (Documentary) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sabata
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A group of thieves rob a safe of $100,000 and plan to use the money to purchase some land near a proposed railway line. The crooks think they've gotten away with their crime, but they haven't figured on Sabata, a violent bounty hunter with no scruples and a strong desire for cash. He teams up with both his partner, Banjo, and a local bandit named Carrincha. Sabata's fast draw and quick wits make life hell for the thieves. (Western) - 1970

But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship. (Western) - 1957

showtimewomen.us.description: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate. - 1987

showtimewomen.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
showtimewomen.us.description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States. - 1999

showtimewomen.us.title: Queen of the Damned
showtimewomen.us.description: The vampire Lestat awakens after 100 years, becomes a rock star and unites with a female counterpart. - 2002

showtimewomen.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimewomen.us.description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor. - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: The Firm
showtimewomen.us.description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse. - 1993

showtimewomen.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimewomen.us.description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams. - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: Beautiful Girls
showtimewomen.us.description: The opposite sex preoccupies working-class pals gathered for their high-school reunion in small-town Massachusetts. - 1996

showtimewomen.us.title: Regarding Henry
showtimewomen.us.description: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter. - 1991

showtimewomen.us.title: Jersey Girl
showtimewomen.us.description: A young woman (Liv Tyler) changes the life of a single father (Ben Affleck) who used to be a successful New York music publicist. - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: The Stepford Wives
showtimewomen.us.description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality. - 2004

showtimewomen.us.title: The Guilt Trip
showtimewomen.us.description: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs. (Comedy, Drama) - 2012

shoxbetwest.us.title: American Son
shoxbetwest.us.description: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving. (Drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
shoxbetwest.us.description: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return. (Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2004

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour
shoxbetwest.us.description: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 1998

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2001

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 3
shoxbetwest.us.description: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. (Action, Comedy, Martial arts) - 2007

shoxbetwest.us.title: Undisputed
shoxbetwest.us.description: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion. (Drama, Action) - 2002

shoxbetwest.us.title: Doubt
shoxbetwest.us.description: In 1964 the winds of change are sweeping through Sister Aloysius' (Meryl Streep) St. Nicholas school. Father Flynn (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a charismatic priest, is advocating reform of the school's strict customs, and the first black student has just been accepted. When a fellow nun (Amy Adams) tells Sister Aloysius that Father Flynn may be paying too much personal attention to the student, Sister Aloysius begins a personal crusade against the priest -- despite her lack of evidence. (Thriller, Mystery, Historical drama) - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: Imagine That
shoxbetwest.us.description: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

shoxbetwest.us.title: One & Done: Ben Simmons
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young man finds success as a basketball player at LSU and prepares for the NBA Draft, in which he is expected to be selected. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2016-10-21

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pariah: The Lives and Deaths of Sonny Liston
shoxbetwest.us.description: The life and suspicious death of boxer Sonny Liston. (Documentary) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
shoxbetwest.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. (Thriller, Drama) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Fighting Temptations
shoxbetwest.us.description: Advertising executive Darrin Hill (Cuba Gooding Jr.) loses his job and his girlfriend after his many lies about his background and education are discovered. Soon after, he returns to his small Georgia hometown to collect an inheritance from his Aunt Sally (Ann Nesby). To receive it, he must lead the church choir to victory in a gospel competition. With the help of childhood friend Lilly (Beyoncé Knowles), now a beautiful singer, Darrin gets the choir ready to perform. (Comedy) - 2003

shoxbetwest.us.title: Whitney: Can I Be Me
shoxbetwest.us.description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield goes in search of the forces that made and then destroyed singer Whitney Houston, who has been described as having one of the greatest voices of the last 50 years. (Documentary, Music) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Dreamgirls
shoxbetwest.us.description: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Norbit
shoxbetwest.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

shoxbetwest.us.title: 48 HRS.
shoxbetwest.us.description: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom. (Action, Comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1983

shoxbetwest.us.title: Another 48 Hrs.
shoxbetwest.us.description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond. This time it is to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco Bay Area. - 1990

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Equalizer 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. - 2018

shoxbetwest.us.title: Virtuosity
shoxbetwest.us.description: An ex-cop doing prison time chases a virtual-reality killer from the program onto the Los Angeles streets. - 1995

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sound of Violence
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: Kokomo City
shoxbetwest.us.description: Four Black transgender sex workers tell their life stories in intimate and candid interviews. - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Persona
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: B******': The Sound and Fury of Rick James
shoxbetwest.us.description: A raw and intimate documentary look at the wildly colorful life of legendary funk artist Rick James; original interviews with artists, collaborators and friends.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
shoxbetwest.us.description: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. They soon find themselves in a fight for survival when a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband. - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: NYC Point Gods
shoxbetwest.us.description: Point guards including Rafer Alston, Kenny Anderson, Mark Jackson, Stephon Marbury, Kenny Smith and Rod Strickland hone their craft and taste for showmanship on New York City's iconic playgrounds and in high school gyms in the 1980s and '90s.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Attica
shoxbetwest.us.description: During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever. - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Honeymooners
shoxbetwest.us.description: New York bus driver Ralph Kramden and pal Ed Norton test their wives' patience with moneymaking schemes that end in failure. - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr. Krabs' life.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Antz
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Flushed Away
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A spoiled but lonely pet rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins, but his attempts to help escalate the conflict put them both in deadly danger.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Rugrats Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Rugrats Go Wild
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wonder Park
skycinemafamily.uk.description: June is a wildly imaginative girl who finds herself in Wonderland -- an amusement park she created in her mind. With the park falling into disarray, she soon teams up with a group of lovable animals to try and save Wonderland before its lost forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
skycinemafamily.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Super-Charlie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Chicken Run
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Trolls
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
skycinemafamily.uk.description: With the evil wizard Gargamel hot on their trail, Smurfette, Brainy, Clumsy and Hefty embark on a journey through the Forbidden Forest to find a mysterious village.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Dog Man
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Addams Family
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

skykids.uk.title: The Pingu Show
skykids.uk.description: Pingu's Admirer / Pingu's Parents Go to a Concert: A new girl at school takes a shine to Pingu! Pingu and Pinga forget about their promise to be good when their parents go out. (S2, ep 37)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: Hide and Sneak: Clifford's size makes things difficult during an epic game of hide-and-seek, so Emily Elizabeth must get creative! (S1, ep 22)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: The Big Red Tomato: Emily Elizabeth and Jack have a disagreement while cooking for the Firehouse Feast, and must put their differences aside in order to save their friendship! (S1, ep 23)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: Dogbot: Emily Elizabeth and Clifford pretend to be robots to quickly finish their chores, but they get carried away and make a lot of mistakes along the way! (S1, ep 24)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: The Birdwell Island Blues: Emily Elizabeth is in a bad mood. Her bad mood causes a chain reaction, and soon almost everyone on the island is unhappy too! (S1, ep 25)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: The Big Red World: When Jack brings out his dad's trunk of global travel treasures, the gang are inspired to go on a 'world tour'! (S1, ep 26)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: A Reasonable Eggsplanation: When Clifford and Emily Elizabeth discover what they think to be a dinosaur egg, they set out to do the right thing and return it to its family. (S1, ep 27)

skykids.uk.title: Clifford
skykids.uk.description: The Special Agents of Birdwell Island: Mr Howard is getting rid of something big and red. Could it be Clifford? Emily Elizabeth and Clifford must solve the mystery. (S1, ep 28)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Bell Ringing Time: Tommy and Tallulah collect McCoggins' bell for a performance but break the ringer and search everywhere for a replacement, trying some very unusual options. (S1, ep 6)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Spring Chicks Time: Tommy and Tallulah try to babysit the chicks at the town kite display which proves too much of a handful. Soon, the twins must stage an airborne rescue! (S1, ep 7)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Cast Envy: Poor Melanie has broken her arm and Miffy becomes jealous of her new cast. When Miffy makes one of her own, she soon realises it's not as fun as she hoped. (S1, ep 21)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Firefly Festival: Miffy organises a big party for the fireflies, planning everything carefully, except perhaps what the fireflies themselves might want... (S1, ep 22)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Whistling Miffy: Grandpa teaches Miffy how to whistle. She enjoys it so much she can't stop, which brings an unexpected visitor to school. (S1, ep 23)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: The Treasure Hunt: Miffy feels frustrated when Melanie gets all the clues right in Daddy's treasure hunt. So, when Daddy drops the answer sheet, she takes a sneaky peek. (S1, ep 24)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Kite or Bike: Miffy visits Ko for their first playdate. They're excited to spend time together, but struggle to find a game they both enjoy. (S1, ep 25)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: The Adventures of Captain Seashell: Ko lends his favourite book to Miffy for a beach day read. When it gets damaged, can Miffy find a way to fix it? (S1, ep 26)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Miffy and Bun Make Art: Miffy worries Baby Bun will ruin her clay artwork but discovers that creating together can lead to unexpected results... (S1, ep 27)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: A Touch of Clouds: Miffy and her friends wonder what clouds feel like. Soft? Fluffy? Bouncy? To find out, Uncle Pilot takes Miffy up into the sky. (S1, ep 28)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: The Golden Ticket: Miffy wins a train contest by repeating Ko's answers, but being a conductor is harder than she thought. Can she tell the truth and help Ko claim his prize? (S1, ep 29)

skykids.uk.title: Miffy And Friends
skykids.uk.description: Turtle Time: While on a farm trip, Miffy hopes she'll get a cuddly farm animal to look after. When she gets a turtle instead, can she learn to love it? (S1, ep 30)

skykids.uk.title: Tickety Toc
skykids.uk.description: Package Time: Tommy and Tallulah deliver a precious package to Madame Au Lait, but a little carelessness on the way sends it on a crazy journey around Tickety Town! (S1, ep 11)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: Herbert's Birthday Party: Herbert the Warthog has a makeover in order to crash his own surprise party. His friends don't recognise him... until he returns to his normal self! (S1, ep 26)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Reginald's Big Sleep: Reginald creates a no-noise zone around him and finds the grass has literally grown under his feet. Normality is restored when he apologises. (S2, ep 1)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of the Dawn Chorus: Doris thinks the normal Dawn Chorus is too disorganised. However, she finds being a maestro hard work, especially when the singers go off in a huff! (S2, ep 2)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Phoebe the Koala: Phoebe gets caught out when trying to take credit for someone else's work. However, she finds her artistic feet with help from Wally the Wombat. (S2, ep 3)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Hercule Moustache: Sidney and Snowbert show their guest Hercule all the sites. At first he's unimpressed and is even a bit rude - but the best is yet to come! (S2, ep 4)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Kevin's Magic Trick: Kevin pretends he is magic and an impressed Doris makes him do a show. A special cloud comes to Kevin's aid and makes it a wonderful occasion. (S2, ep 5)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Isabel the Flamingo: Isabel gives Pauline a makeover, only for her to ruin it by helping her friends with messy chores. Isabel soon learns looks aren't everything. (S2, ep 6)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of the Watermelon of Doom: Herbert's watermelon obsession provides Victor with the perfect tool for revenge on the animals at the waterhole. (S2, ep 7)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of Alan the Aardvark: The animals send Alan on holiday due to his boring ant obsession. When the ants get out of control, he returns to save the day. Phew! (S2, ep 8)

skykids.uk.title: 64 Zoo Lane
skykids.uk.description: The Story of the Important Visitor: The animals get excited by a rumour that a special guest is on her way, but their welcoming party gets ruined. What will the visitor think? (S2, ep 9)

skykids.uk.title: Pingu In The City

skyselect.uk.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas (2000)
skyselect.uk.description: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all. (Comedy / Fantasy / Children / Holiday) - 2000

skyselect.uk.title: Four Christmases (2008)
skyselect.uk.description: When a couple's tropical Christmas holiday is cancelled they are forced to pay visits to all four of their divorced parents in one day. (Romantic comedy / Holiday) - 2008

skyselect.uk.title: The Polar Express (2004)
skyselect.uk.description: A young boy who doesn't believe in Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters where he learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas. (Fantasy / Animated / Children / Holiday) - 2004

skyselect.uk.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (1989)
skyselect.uk.description: Clark Griswold sets out to give his family a traditional Christmas. While his in-laws, among them a cousin from hell, sample his hospitality, they find themselves battling against rabid squirrels, and an exploding sewer to achieve a family Christmas that they will never forget. (Comedy / Holiday) - 1989

skyselect.uk.title: Scrooged (1988)
skyselect.uk.description: Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, `A Christmas Carol'. (Comedy / Fantasy / Holiday) - 1988

skyselect.uk.title: Love Actually (2003)
skyselect.uk.description: Weaving in and out of the love lives of eight loosely inter-related couples. The bachelor Prime Minister falls for his personal assistant, his brother-in-law is flirting with one of his colleagues, a writer heads off to France and pursues an affair with a maid, and an 11-year-old boy asks his father for advice on matters of the heart. - 2003

skyselect.uk.title: The Holiday (2006)
skyselect.uk.description: Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up. (Romantic comedy / Holiday) - 2006

skyselect.uk.title: Last Christmas (2019)
skyselect.uk.description: Nothing seems to go right for young Kate, a frustrated Londoner who works as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop. But things soon take a turn for the better when she develops a growing attraction to a charming suitor who seems too good to be true. (Romantic comedy / Holiday) - 2019

skyselect.uk.title: Just Friends (2005)
skyselect.uk.description: An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan. (Romantic comedy) - 2005
