teennick.us.description: As Sarah and Gideon's crushes on Max and Phoebe escalate, the twins attempt to solve the problem by setting them up on a date with each other; Max wants to win back Sarah after he discovers her uncle is a rock star. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-01-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Amazing Rat Race
teennick.us.description: Max turns Billy into the world's fastest rat in order to win the rat races that he has with members of his band. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2015-03-03

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - The Max of Life
teennick.us.description: Max misses being famous and having fans; he decides to break Booch's sandwich-stacking record to be famous again; Chloe rallies behind Booch, so that she can take back her record. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-08-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Endless Summer
teennick.us.description: Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-08-02

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Mall Time Crooks
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max head out on a trip to the mall to buy Hank's birthday gift and end up having a run-in with security. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2015-03-04

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Side-Kicking and Screaming
teennick.us.description: Max & Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule, but the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-03-03

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Weekend Guest
teennick.us.description: Phoebe volunteers to take home the class's Venus flytrap for the weekend; Max performs an experiment on a plant, causing it to grow continuously. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2013-12-07

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Date of Emergency
teennick.us.description: Phoebe fakes a romance after feeling left out with her friends all in relationships, but maintaining the lie proves to be harder than she expected. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-02-04

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Thundersense
teennick.us.description: Phoebe gets the ability to sense danger and uses it to impress her classmates; Max tries to get pity gifts from Barb. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-03-15

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Phoebe's a Clone Now
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe gets too busy, Max tries to help her out by creating a clone of her so she can be in two places at once; but things go sideways when the clone starts to create problems for the real Phoebe. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2014-03-15

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Cookie Mistake
teennick.us.description: After Phoebe chooses Billy to accompany her to their favorite cookie factory's exclusive tasting event, Max and Nora are determined to sneak in and get to the delicious treats first. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-03-10

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Evil Never Sleeps
teennick.us.description: Phoebe's allegiance is torn when she learns that her boyfriend's father might be plotting a return to evil. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-10-07

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Why You Buggin'?
teennick.us.description: After discovering that Link's ex-girlfriend is a secret supervillain, Phoebe enlists Max's help in exposing her rival's true motives. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-07-18

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Nothing to Lose Sleepover
teennick.us.description: Phoebe is caught using telekinesis to save her first sleepover from becoming a disaster; Phoebe must wear an anklet that prevents her from using her powers. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2014-04-26

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Ditch Day
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe create some fun for themselves on Ditch Day. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2013-11-23

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Restaurant Crashers
teennick.us.description: When the children accidentally ruin Hank's anniversary gift for Barb, they enlist the help of a family friend to help them fix it. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-02-15

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Love Is in the Lair
teennick.us.description: Mrs. Wong visits Secret Shores and threatens to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town; but Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr. Colosso keep her quiet backfires in ways they could not have imagined. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-09-20

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - All About Steve
teennick.us.description: Billy brings a new sidekick, Steve, to town and wants him to join the T-Force; Phoebe and Max agree to consider him, but when they eventually reject Steve for having a very lame power, he turns evil. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2025-03-21

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Attention Deficit; Out on a Limo
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins spending time at Clyde's house when Clyde's fathers give him more attention than he gets at home; when Lincoln wins a ride in a limo, he begins to change after getting a taste of the good life.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Out of Step; Too Cool for School
teennick.us.description: Clyde and Nana Gayle are in stiff competition when they make the finals of a Grandmother/Grandson Dance Contest; Lincoln and friends need to get school back to normal when Principal Ramirez implements new fishy rules.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Hurt Lockers; Love Stinks
teennick.us.description: When a sinkhole opens up at school, Lincoln and his classmates are forced to share lockers; when Lana brings home a skunk to rehabilitate, Lola grows attached when she finds the skunk has finer tastes.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Crying Dame; Anti Social
teennick.us.description: The children give Lily an old singing toy from the attic to help her stop crying, but it quickly drives them crazy; the kids try to convince Dad of the wonders of modern technology after he declares war on their electronic devices.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stage Plight; Antiqued Off
teennick.us.description: Luan tries out for the school play to get closer to her crush, Benny; when Clyde and schoolmate Zach begin bonding over a mutual interest in antiques, Lincoln quickly finds himself feeling like a third wheel.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Baby Steps; Brawl in the Family
teennick.us.description: When Clyde thinks that his parents are having another baby, he seeks Lincoln's advice on how to be a big brother; a fight breaks out in the Loud house when Lori and Leni buy identical dresses.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Really Loud Music
teennick.us.description: Hoping to win a songwriting contest, Luna contemplates whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound or try to make something that the whole world will love.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Appetite for Destruction; Frame on You
teennick.us.description: When Lily starts misbehaving at home, Mom and Dad think her new preschool friends might be the cause; when Rusty is wrongfully suspended, the Action News Team leaps into action to clear his name.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Sound of Silence; Space Invader
teennick.us.description: Lincoln uses sound-canceling ear buds to try and drown out his sisters; after Lynn and Lucy get in a fight, Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room for one night.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Summer Camp: The Grate Outdoors; Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool
teennick.us.description: At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous; when Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Bug's Strife; All the Rage
teennick.us.description: Dad tears the house apart trying to find the cricket ruining his peaceful day alone in the house; tired of getting pummeled during dodgeball, Lincoln and the gang use Clyde's untapped rage without him knowing.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lock 'N Loud; The Whole Picture
teennick.us.description: When Dad gets upset with the children for never locking the front door, they decide to take home security to the next level; when Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he and Clyde attempt to recreate them before his memory fades.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Gown and Out; Breaking Dad
teennick.us.description: When Lola advances to a regional pageant she worries she could lose for the first time; Dad has Mr. Grouse watch Lily while he goes to a concert, but things quickly start to go wrong.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Flip This Flip; Haunted House Call
teennick.us.description: The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush; when the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cat-astrophe; Prize Fighter
teennick.us.description: The McBrides plan a birthday party for Nana Gayle; Lola worries she's a washed-up pageant star.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Teacher's Union; Head Poet's Anxiety
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde set Coach Pacowski and Mrs. Johnson up in an effort to make gym class better; Luan teaches Lucy how to manage the ups and downs of pursuing a life in the arts.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fam Scam; Farm to Unstable
teennick.us.description: Embarrassed by her family, Lola pretends to be a McBride to impress her new sophisticated pageant friend; after realizing farm work with Liam is harder than they thought, Lincoln and the gang look for shortcuts.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Picture Perfect; Undie Pressure
teennick.us.description: Lincoln hatches a plan to capture the perfect family photograph for his parents' anniversary gift; Lincoln and his sisters make a bet on who can go the longest without engaging in their most annoying habits.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lincoln Loud: Girl Guru; Come Sale Away
teennick.us.description: Lincoln and Clyde must start a business for a class assignment, so they decide to sell Lincoln's girl expertise; the children are determined to out-sell each other at the Loud family's annual garage sale.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Ruthless People; What Wood Lincoln Do?
teennick.us.description: When termites infest the house, half the family stays with Pop Pop and the others stay with Aunt Ruth; Lincoln has to complete a woodworking assignment, but has a history of failure on the topic.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Can't Hardly Wait; A Mutt Above
teennick.us.description: Lori takes a job as a waitress at Dad's restaurant, but it turns out that serving is harder than she anticipated; spurred on by a classmate's mocking about Charles, Lana decides to train him to compete in a local dog show.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Absent Minded; Be Stella My Heart
teennick.us.description: Clyde discovers he didn't earn junior administrator job, but can't give up the perks that come along with it; when the new girl starts hanging around Lincoln and his friends, they begin to suspect she likes one of them.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Selfie Improvement; No Place Like Homeschool
teennick.us.description: When Carol Pingrey's photograph gets more "likes" on social media than Lori's, she tries to one-up her; thinking it looks like fun, the other kids try to get in on Lola's home-schooling.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Present Danger; Stressed for the Part
teennick.us.description: Dressed as David Steele, Lincoln is on the hunt for his stolen birthday present before it's destroyed; after landing a role in a Dairyland production, Luan must hide this news from Mrs. Bernardo, whom she beat out.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Fool's Paradise; Job Insecurity
teennick.us.description: The Loud family believe that they are safe from pranks on April Fool's Day because prankster Luan is away at camp; when the children discover that their father is not at his old job anymore, they begin to worry it might be their fault.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - April Fools Rules; Cereal Offender
teennick.us.description: Luna pranks the entire household every year on April Fools' Day, but this year Lincoln has a plan to avoid her pranks; the Loud children make a trip to the supermarket to do the grocery shopping for their mother, but Lincoln has other plans.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Road Trip: Screen Queen; Road Trip: Hide and Sneak
teennick.us.description: When the Louds' road trip takes them to Hollywood, Lola is determined to become a star and land a leading role; to help Mom make the deadline for her column, the Louds have to avoid the Casagrandes when they visit Great Lakes City.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Hand-Me-Downer; Sleuth or Consequences
teennick.us.description: After Lincoln gets a pink hand-me-down bike from Lori, he borrows Lynn's cool BMX bike without telling her; when someone clogs the toilet, Lincoln investigates to find the culprit.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Zach Attack; Flying Solo
teennick.us.description: Zach and Rusty fake an alien landing, which sends the whole town on a hunt for little green men; Clyde thinks he's guaranteed the Glee Club solo, until Lincoln accidentally auditions and lands the part.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Face the Music With the Casagrandes; Pranks for the Memories With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When Ronnie Anne discovers that each family member will perform at Hector's birthday, she turns to Sid for help; Ronnie Anne's attempts to bond with her cool older cousin Carlota lead to a prank war against the boy cousins.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Breaking Dad
teennick.us.description: While teaching at Max and Phoebe's school, Hank falls asleep after eating special turkey sandwiches.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Save the Past Dance
teennick.us.description: Tired of hearing tales of Hiddenville's legendary mayor, the kids use a time machine to travel back 60 years to disprove the myths; but when they inadvertently alter the past, the effect spells disaster for their hometown.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - All the President's Thunder-Men
teennick.us.description: After their requests drive Kickbutt to quit, Max and Phoebe get what they want when Hank is named the new SuperPresident; being the First Family of the Hero League takes its toll on the family.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Come What Mayhem
teennick.us.description: Phoebe makes a life-altering decision when her powers combined with Max's powers are not enough to stop one of Max's old pranks from ruining a superhero gathering.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Doubles Trouble
teennick.us.description: Phoebe enlists Max's help in a tennis tournament in order to win a membership at Link's family's country club.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - May Z-Force Be With You
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe ask Cherry to secretly fill-in after Phoebe injures herself the night before a meeting with the Z-Force.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Paging Dr. Thunderman
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe take Billy to the hospital when he hurts his thumb; Max faints when he sees a needle.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Faulty Powers
teennick.us.description: A training accident makes Chloe's powers faulty; Max tries to cure her and gets a misleading positive result, so she goes to a party; but his treatment actually creates brand-new powers Chloe can't control.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Summer of Secrets
teennick.us.description: Chloe has been missing school by going on missions with her siblings; she has to go to summer school to catch up on everything she has missed; Max, acting as the substitute for summer school, has a new student who agrees to tutor her.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - No Country for Old Mentors
teennick.us.description: Despite hoping to be matched with her favorite hero in the Superhero Mentor Program, Phoebe feels pressure to choose her father instead.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Rhythm n' Shoes
teennick.us.description: Determined to meet a famous pop singer visiting Hiddenville High, Phoebe and Max devise elaborate schemes to insert themselves into her performance that quickly lead to disastrous results.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Patch Me If You Can
teennick.us.description: While Phoebe is baby-sitting her boyfriend's brother, the boy discovers his evil side after getting his hands on one of Max's inventions.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - I'm Gonna Forget You, Sucka
teennick.us.description: After Cherry accidentally posts a photo revealing the Thundermans' secret, the Hero League forces Phoebe to end the relationship with her best friend.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Smells Like Team Spirit
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max must work together on a series of superhero team-building exercises, but their different approaches to training jeopardizes their future as a crime fighting duo.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Parents Just Don't Thunderstand
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max use one of his devices to make Hank and Barb act like teenagers, but the siblings quickly grow to regret their actions.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Robin Hood: Prince of Pheebs
teennick.us.description: When Chloe announces that Max is her favorite sibling, Phoebe tries to reveal Max's true colors using a bedtime story.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Chutes and Splatters
teennick.us.description: Phoebe must baby-sit President Kuckbutt's troublemaking teen daughter as her latest superhero mission, but the assignment quickly gets out of control.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Back to School
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max return to their elementary school to complete a hero assessment exam and discover that the instructor is a former classmate that Max tormented.

themoviechannel.us.title: Moonage Daydream
themoviechannel.us.description: Featuring never-before-seen footage and performances, filmmaker Brett Morgen explores David Bowie's creative, spiritual and musical journey. (Documentary, Music, Rock, Pop) - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: Almost Famous
themoviechannel.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Footloose
themoviechannel.us.description: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way. (Drama, Music, Romance, Comedy) - 1984

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike
themoviechannel.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. (Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. (Comedy drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Comet
themoviechannel.us.description: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower. (Romance, Comedy drama) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Regarding Henry
themoviechannel.us.description: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. (Drama) - 1991

themoviechannel.us.title: An Unfinished Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Shall We Dance?
themoviechannel.us.description: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret. (Romantic comedy, Drama, Music) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Wakefield
themoviechannel.us.description: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. (Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Surviving Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco and his wife, Christine, a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents. Soon Drew tests the couple's patience, and, when their daughter, Alicia, arrives, things get increasingly tense. (Holiday, Dark comedy, Romantic comedy) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 1987

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gone With the Wind
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Presented as originally released in 1939. Includes themes and character depictions which may be offensive and problematic to contemporary audiences. Epic Civil War drama focuses on the life of petulant Southern belle Scarlett O'Hara. Starting with her idyllic life on a sprawling plantation, the film traces her survival through the tragic history of the South during the Civil War and Reconstruction, and her tangled love affairs with Ashley Wilkes and Rhett Butler. (Romance, Historical drama, War) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strategic Air Command
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Saga of the US Air Force special bomber unit during the Cold War era. A professional baseball player is recalled to military service because of the expert flying skills he acquired during World War II. Although the athlete and his wife are both reluctant to give up civilian life, both come to realize the importance of the defense mission. The film features spectacular aerial footage of big bombers on maneuvers. (Adventure) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mountain Road
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Maj. Baldwin (James Stewart) is an American officer stationed in China during World War II charged with stopping the advance of the Japanese army and protecting civilians. One of his tasks is destroying infrastructure to stop the progress of enemy troops. Baldwin is put in command of a unit and is taken aback by how primitive China is. He meets widow Sue-Mei Hung (Lisa Lu) who attempts to explain local customs, but she is ultimately put off by his brutal methods. (War, Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Garden of Eden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Toni LeBrun (Corinne Griffith) is beautiful jazz age singer who takes a job in a Paris cabaret, where she is propositioned by Henry von Glessing (Lowell Sherman), a rich patron of the club. When she refuses his advances, she is fired and joins her wardrobe mistress, Rosa (Louise Dresser), in a fancy hotel in Monte Carlo -- where Rosa reveals herself as a down-on-her-luck baroness in disguise. Posing as the daughter of the baroness, Toni pursues romance, with unexpected consequences. (Romantic comedy) - 1928

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Zazie Dans le Métro
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An 11-year-old girl causes chaos on the streets of Paris after she runs away from her transvestite uncle. (Comedy) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murmur of the Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This loosely plotted coming-of-age tale follows the life of 15-year-old Laurent Chevalier (Benoît Ferreux) as he stumbles his way over the burgeoning swell of adolescence in the 1950s France. After having his first sexual experience with a prostitute and dodging the lips of a priest (Michel Lonsdale), Chevalier contracts a case of scarlet fever. When the fever leaves him with a heart murmur, Chevalier is placed in a sanatorium, along with his over-attentive and adulterous mother (Léa Massari). (Comedy drama) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: You're Only Young Once
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone), wife Emily, daughter Marian (Cecilia Parker), and son Andy (Mickey Rooney) prepare for their annual vacation. The judge chooses Santa Catalina Island for the good fishing, and everyone settles into their idea of fun. Marian flirts with a wealthy lifeguard who claims to be separated from his wife, and Andy is drawn to an equally wealthy fast girl. But the Hardys' relaxation comes to a halt when the judge learns he has been swindled back home. (Comedy drama) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Andy Hardy's Double Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: College-bound Andy Hardy (Mickey Rooney) sells a friend his old jalopy in order to afford to ship his new car to school. After mailing a check away, Andy discovers his friend can't cover the payment and turns to his sister, Marian (Cecilia Parker), and his father, Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone), for help. Meanwhile, exasperated by Andy's constant flirtations, his girlfriend, Polly (Ann Rutherford), plots to teach Andy a lesson in romance with her sophisticated friend, Sheila (Esther Williams). (Comedy) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Four Girls in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Norma (Florence Rice), Mary (Mary Howard), Pat (Ann Rutherford) and Gertie (Una Merkel) are four nursing students hoping that their long education and investment will lead to a well-paying, stable job. When Bob Maitland (Kent Taylor), the son of their hospital's founder, is checked in, Norma falls for his good looks and his fabulous wealth. When she neglects her other patients to dote on Bob, however, her position in the hospital is put in jeopardy. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pride and Prejudice
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early 19th century in the English village of Meryton, the arrival of wealthy bachelors, most notably Mr. Darcy (Laurence Olivier), stirs up the families with single daughters. Among those is the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters, including the spirited Elizabeth (Greer Garson) and her pretty older sister, Jane (Maureen O'Sullivan). As Mrs. Bennet (Mary Boland) aggressively tries to pair off her girls, Elizabeth crosses swords with the imperious Darcy. (Romantic comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in the Dark
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wally Benton (Red Skelton) isn't a detective, but he plays one on the radio. The confusion between Benton and his crime-solving persona results in a rather perilous situation when cult leader Joseph Jones (Conrad Veidt), greedy for the inheritance of one of his flock, blackmails Benton to craft the perfect murder. Under the watchful eye of Jones' burly thug, Sylvester (Rags Ragland), the actor has to hatch a flawless plot -- or improvise his way out of his predicament. He has until 11 o'clock. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Whistling in Brooklyn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A murderer, dubbed the Constant Reader for sending notes to the police with exact locations and descriptions of victims, eludes Inspector Holcomb (Henry O'Neill). On a radio program called The Fox, hosted by Wally Benton (Red Skelton), Holcomb hears Wally describe a letter that sounds similar to those from the Constant Reader. Wally, who is about to marry co-star Carol Lambert (Ann Rutherford), is then pursued by the police and determined cub reporter Jean Pringle (Jean Rogers). (Comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Ghost Comes Home
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A missing man (Frank Morgan) returns and learns his wife (Billie Burke) collected on his life insurance. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Keeping Company
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A real-estate broker (Frank Morgan) and his wife advise the eldest (Ann Rutherford) of their three daughters about marriage. (Romantic comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Two O'Clock Courage
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A confused man (Tom Conway) with a gash on his head stumbles into the taxi of cabbie Patty Mitchell (Ann Rutherford). He says that he can't recall his own name, any facts about his life or even what he was doing before he got in the cab. The sympathetic Patty decides to help him try to reassemble the pieces of his past, but, as they scour the city for clues, they learn the cops are investigating a murder that took place just prior to the man's blackout -- and he fits the killer's description. (Mystery) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: King of Jazz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This lost film found in 1970 features dance numbers, pioneer special effects, animation, the Rhythm Boys with Bing Crosby. (Musical) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hollywood Canteen
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A GI (Robert Hutton) back from the South Pacific wins a canteen raffle and meets his dream girl (Joan Leslie), as Warner Bros. stars perform. - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thank Your Lucky Stars
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Hollywood tour-bus guide (Eddie Cantor) joins a wartime revue with Joan Leslie, Bette Davis, Errol Flynn and Warner Bros. stars. - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thousands Cheer

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Two Girls and a Sailor
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A sailor (Van Johnson) from a rich family meets a nightclub-singing sister act (June Allyson, Gloria DeHaven) in wartime New York. - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: That Midnight Kiss
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Philadelphia debutante (Kathryn Grayson) talks her opera maestro (Jose Iturbi) into giving a GI tenor (Mario Lanza) a chance. - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Holiday in Mexico
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The U.S. ambassador's (Walter Pidgeon) daughter falls for a Mexican pianist (Jose Iturbi) old enough to be her grandfather. - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: His Majesty O'Keefe
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A sea captain (Burt Lancaster) marries an islander (Joan Rice) and becomes a South Pacific king of dried coconut meat. - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: South Sea Woman
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A World War II Marine (Burt Lancaster) tells a court-martial where he, his buddy (Chuck Connors) and a nightclub camera-girl (Virginia Mayo) have been. - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Flame and the Arrow
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An acrobatic rebel (Burt Lancaster) and his band of mountain men trick Hessian mercenaries in medieval Italy. - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Crimson Pirate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Capt. Vallo, the leader of a roving band of pirates, hijacks a ship filled with expensive cargo. When a crew member tells him the ship was bound for an island whose inhabitants have risen up against the king, Vallo hatches a scheme to sell guns to the rebels and take their leader in for a reward. But once Vallo and his lieutenant, Ojo, are on the island, their plans change when they meet Consuelo and the other resistance fighters. (Adventure) - 1952

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
actionmax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
actionmax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Predator
actionmax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Watchers
actionmax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Nerve

Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
moremax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Beirut
moremax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Companion
moremax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Thriller, Science fiction, Horror, Dark comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Bring Her Back
moremax.us.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother. (Horror, Thriller) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
moremax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

moremax.us.title: Hoot
moremax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

moremax.us.title: Leave No Trace
moremax.us.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own. (Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Hitchcock
moremax.us.description: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
moremax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E46 Wacky Wiggles When a Wiggles update goes wrong, Bitsy and Buddy learn to listen to instructions, so they can save Wiggles from Cat Burglar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E1 The Toothbrushing Badge It's up to Duggee and the Squirrels to convince Alan to take care of his teeth, and show him exactly how to brush them! With a catchy song, of course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E42 The Owl Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig build a special bird watching hut so that they can spot an owl at night.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 Empathy Lou explains to Marzipan what hugs are for.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 How to Hoverboard Cosima and Big Lizard's solar-powered hoverboards run out of battery as night falls. Some troublesome glowbugs are attracted to Big Lizard's dinner and manage to save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 The Octonauts and the Hungry Pilot Fish A lost Pilot Fish who eats ocean gunk cleans up the Octonauts' dirty Gups - but he's still hungry! Meanwhile, Captain Barnacles must figure out why a Whitetip Shark is chasing the Gup-A!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends ᴺᵉʷ

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E47 Cricket During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Present Day Flower wants new toys, but Penny says she has too many. Flower decides to give away her old stuff and discovers that sharing sparks unexpected fun for herself and all her friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E27 Lucy's Sleepover Holly shrinks Lucy down so she can play in the Little Kingdom. She has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 The Nest Minty tries to fly and is mistaken for a Baby Bokchoydacty by its mother who takes Minty back to their nest. Ginger needs a rescue plan and fast!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 Little Trev's Turtle Big Trev tells Pounce and Gemma a tale from his childhood as they wait for his elderly turtle friend, Salty, to arrive.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E18 Andy and the Waved Albatross When a waved albatross snatches Mr Hammond's pocket bird guide book from Jen, it's up to Andy to find it and bring it home. Blasting off in his safari sub, Andy heads to the Galapagos Islands in search of the lost book.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E13 Marvellous Maths: 3 Lily joins Rachael and Emma in the lab for a guessing game to estimate how many balls, chickpeas and grains of rice fill up containers. They play another game using dice and numbers to stack the correct number of boxes!

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E23 The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E24 The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E25 The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E26 The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E1 The Ribos Operation: Part 1 On a mission to collect the six segments of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Ribos where the first segment is protected by the monstrous Shrivenzale.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E14 The Sun Makers: Part 2 The Doctor is taken prisoner by the Gatherer and sent to the Correction Centre. Leela mounts a rescue attempt, but the Gatherer’s men are waiting.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E16 The Sun Makers: Part 4 The Others launch a full-scale uprising against the Gatherer and his Inner Retinue while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E17 Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E18 Underworld: Part 2 When their ship crashes beneath the surface of a newly formed planet, the Minyan survivors discover what they have been searching for. But their arrival is not welcomed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E19 Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E20 Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E21 The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E22 The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E5 The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E6 The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E7 The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E8 The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E9 The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E10 The Stones of Blood: Part 2 The leaders of a druidic cult have been killed and it seems that the stones from the stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E11 The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E12 The Stones of Blood: Part 4 The Doctor releases two alien justice machines from imprisonment who sentenc him to death. Meanwhile Romana urgently searches for clues that will reveal Vivien Fay’s true identity.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E13 The Androids of Tara: Part 1 Arriving on Tara, Romana locates the fourth segment of the Key to Time with ease, but is captured by the scheming Count Grendel who wants the throne of Tara for himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E14 The Androids of Tara: Part 2 Grendel kidnaps Prince Reynart and seems set to be chosen as Tara’s monarch when Reynart fails to arrive at his coronation. But the Doctor has a plan to scupper the Count’s scheme.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E15 The Androids of Tara: Part 3 While Romana makes her escape from the castle, the Doctor is lured to a meeting with an android duplicate of her that is programmed to kill him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E5 The Invisible Enemy: Part 1 An alien virus infects the human crew of a refuelling station on Titan, one of the moons of Saturn. The Doctor is also infected and becomes possessed by the will of the Nucleus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E13 The Androids of Tara: Part 1 Arriving on Tara, Romana locates the fourth segment of the Key to Time with ease, but is captured by the scheming Count Grendel who wants the throne of Tara for himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E14 The Androids of Tara: Part 2 Grendel kidnaps Prince Reynart and seems set to be chosen as Tara’s monarch when Reynart fails to arrive at his coronation. But the Doctor has a plan to scupper the Count’s scheme.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E15 The Androids of Tara: Part 3 While Romana makes her escape from the castle, the Doctor is lured to a meeting with an android duplicate of her that is programmed to kill him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E2 The Ribos Operation: Part 2 Garron is attempting to trick the Graff Vynda-K into buying the planet Ribos, but the jethrik that is vital to his plan is really the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E3 The Ribos Operation: Part 3 The Doctor and Romana's search for the first segment of the Key to Time is hampered when the Graff Vynda-K takes them prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E4 The Ribos Operation: Part 4 Pursued into the catacombs by the Graff and attacked by the ferocious Shrivenzale, the Doctor and Romana struggle to stay alive and find the first segment of the Key to Time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E5 The Pirate Planet: Part 1 In search of the second segment of the Key to Time, the Doctor and Romana travel to the planet Calufrax. But they find that a completely different planet has taken its place.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E6 The Pirate Planet: Part 2 Still in search of the missing planet, Calufrax, the Doctor and Romana encounter the telepathic Mentiads and Zanak’s ruler, the half man, half robot Captain.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E7 The Pirate Planet: Part 3 The Doctor has discovered the sinister truth about Zanak and solved the mystery of the missing planet. On the Bridge, the Doctor meets the real ruler of Zanak.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E8 The Pirate Planet: Part 4 The Doctor and Romana join forces with the Mentiads to prevent the Captain and Xanxia from using Zanak to consume the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E9 The Stones of Blood: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana track the third segment of the Key to Time to the vicinity of an ancient stone circle on Earth. But sinister forces are at work and the stones hide a secret.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E10 The Stones of Blood: Part 2 The leaders of a druidic cult have been killed and it seems that the stones from the stone circle are alive and have a taste for human blood.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E11 The Stones of Blood: Part 3 As the blood hungry Ogri close in, the Doctor launches a desperate attempt to rescue Romana from hyperspace.

BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E16 The Androids of Tara: Part 4 The Doctor attempts to gain entry to the castle to prevent the marriage of Romana to Prince Reynart and thwart Grendal’s plans to rule Tara.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E17 The Power of Kroll: Part 1 Tracing the fifth segment of the Key to Time to the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in the conflict between humans and the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E18 The Power of Kroll: Part 2 The Doctor arrives in time to save Romana from being sacrificed to the bogus god, Kroll. But it’s not long before the very real Kroll makes its terrifying appearance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E19 The Power of Kroll: Part 3 With the giant, squid-like Kroll awake and angry, the Swampies are eager to appease their god by using the Doctor and Romana as sacrificial victims.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E20 The Power of Kroll: Part 4 With Kroll on the rampage, the Doctor and Romana are appalled to discover that Thawn intends to fire a rocket at the creature which will also kill the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E1 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro where the Doctor and the newly regenerated Romana discover that someone is digging deep beneath the planet’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E2 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 2 Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans who are equally interested in discovering exactly what the Daleks are searching for.

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E3 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 3 Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor before the Daleks can reach him. But the Daleks will stop at nothing to recover their creator.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Guitars Dr Karl visits a guitar factory to see how Australia's favourite instrument is made. Precision machines and master craftspeople work in harmony to cut, shape, bend, sand, brace, glue, paint and coax a guitar into existence.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E6 North East George meets Mark along with his daughters, who plan to build a camping trailer from an old Saab, and inspirational teacher Busola who plans to create a cutting edge mobile classroom out of a double decker bus.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E6 Lollipop Man Lucy finds that Fred the school lollipop man has been giving the children actual lollipops, so she puts the family on a healthy eating kick (much to Lee's disdain) and complains anonymously to council about Fred's actions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Zoe is in the firing line when an undercover police officer - posing as a gang member - is shot dead, leaving a grieving widow and a lot of unanswered questions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Ribble Valley, Lancashire Young couple Chris and Ellie Hindle build a home in Lancashire's Ribble Valley where Chris grew up. They are determined to be in by Christmas and time is of the essence, as Chris has stage four cancer.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E5 Ghosts On a stormy Halloween, the Healthmobile travels to a dangerous part of town. A devoted husband's deep love for his dying wife leads Jeanie to tell Al what a rotten man he is. Carter breaks bad news to an injured youngster.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E10 Flora And Fauna Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Jimmy Carr, John Sergeant, Alan Davies and Jo Brand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E3 Episode 3 Rob Brydon, Lee Mack, and David Mitchell are joined by guests Charlie Brooker, Professor Hannah Fry, Danny Jones, and Shaparak Khorsandi.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E16 Episode 16 On this extra-sticky episode of Mythbusters, we put a classic physics ‘thought-problem’ to the test, and then take on two ‘magic bullet’ myths- one from television, and the other from an American frontier legend.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E11 Episode 11 From some 2000 applicants, 72 artists made it to the heats 8 made it to the semi-final, and just 3 to the final, where our worthy winner for this eighth series of Portrait Artist of the Year was selected.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E7 Yorkshire George meets Jasmine and Rupert, who plan to convert an old German fire truck into a cabin on wheels, and inspirational businessman Phil, who's spent thousands transforming an old fly-tipping site into a nature reserve.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E21 Episode 21 Johnny Ball, Suzi Ruffell, Nina Wadia and Danny Wallace test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E11 Robert Baxter, Angie Hart, Zoe Coombs Marr & Noah Szto Ballroom meets Kelly Street with Robert Baxter, Angie Hart, Zoe Coombs Marr and Noah Szto to compete for musical trivia glory, while diagnosing musos and spanking Frank Sinatra. Paul Dempsey turns back time with his cover.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S22 E11 Vintage Join Sandi Toksvig for a Vintage episode of QI with Susan Calman, Rosie Jones, Josh Widdicombe, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E9 Anna Maxwell Martin, Martin Lewis, Alex Jones & Johnny Vegas Rob Brydon hosts the award-winning comedy panel show, with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Johnny Vegas, Alex Jones, Martin Lewis and Anna Maxwell Martin.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E12 The Penn and Teller 50th Anniversary Special Magicians include Young & Strange, Piff and Piero Venesia, and there's an amazing two-act trick by Penn & Teller.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E8 Jonathan Mangum Aisha Tyler hosts another spectacular episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jonathan Mangum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E7 Sober Companions Holmes and Watson find themselves on the hunt for a serial killer after a murder rocks their inner circle.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Fear of Flying Susan and Mark rush to a car accident in a helicopter. Jeanie and Doyle keep a dead man on ice for cryogenic storage. Benton makes an error during surgery that threatens a baby's life, and Carol clashes with an inept nurse.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E6 Lollipop Man Lucy finds that Fred the school lollipop man has been giving the children actual lollipops, so she puts the family on a healthy eating kick (much to Lee's disdain) and complains anonymously to council about Fred's actions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Rage: Guest Programmer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E306 rage Guest Programmer: Grace Cummings Powerful singer-songwriter Grace Cummings brings her knack for deeply personal storytelling to the rage couch, lining up music videos from artists like Primal Scream, Aretha Franklin, Madonna and more.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Zoe is in the firing line when an undercover police officer - posing as a gang member - is shot dead, leaving a grieving widow and a lot of unanswered questions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined in her Cotswold Kitchen by Fearne Cotton.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Tastes Of Tuscany Mary commemorates her recent travels by creating tasty dishes inspired by Italy, like apple raspberry crostata and mushroom crespelle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E21 My Goats & Ricotta Lidia grew up around goats, and their delicious milk which were used to make ricotta. She makes spinach ricotta dumplings, an open cookie cannoli, and then ricotta meatloaf with tomato sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Australia Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Kruger Safari Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Nice Our journey heads to Nice the vibrant capital of the French Riviera. For this special day, Luana has designed an itinerary full of surprises, where tradition meets creativity.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lund, Sweden In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year-old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cooking With Grapes Raise a toast to the glorious grape as Simon and Maggie celebrate with the fruit of the vine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E26 Episode 26 Laura makes her delicious Spinach and Feta Rolls in the heart of the Prahran Market. In the Yarra Valley, Charlie Carrington cooks Chicken Enchiladas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E26 Pesto 2.0 Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a Pesto alla Trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Clontarf Clontarf Reserve is the perfect spot for a BBQ, and Hayden turns things up a notch with recipes featuring beef steaks, lamb cutlets and a pork loin rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E4 Wendell Pierce Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce is joining Ina for cooking and conversation at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E21 Episode 21 Laura starts the show in the historic Prahran Market making a simple and heart-warming Potato and Leek Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Featuring Matt Keenan, Gary brings together fresh, lively flavours in a menu of poke bowl with salmon, cucumber salad, and a Greek style fetta and greens pie served with Yemeni sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E50 Episode 50 Spicy Prawn Tacos and a way to tame those spices with a special visit from Thomas Schnetzler from Lindt who makes a decadent Chocolate Truffle Cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Justine has big plans for a mountaintop picnic-but the Norwegian weather has other ideas. She takes shelter in a mountain hut instead, where she puts together a beautiful spread of open sandwiches.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Rice And Peaches Chef Tom Kerridge's journey takes him to Catalonia in his bespoke vintage food truck as he heads to the Ebro Delta, where rice fields cover the landscape.

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath
fxm.us.description: In 1946 Rachael Morgan arrives in the ruins of Hamburg to be reunited with her husband, Lewis, who is a British colonel charged with rebuilding the shattered city. As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
fxm.us.description: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: A Journal for Jordan
fxm.us.description: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family. (Drama, Romance) - 2021

fxm.us.title: Lincoln
fxm.us.description: With the nation embroiled in still another year with the high death count of Civil War, President Abraham Lincoln brings the full measure of his passion, humanity and political skill to what would become his defining legacy: to end the war and permanently abolish slavery through the 13th Amendment. Having great courage, acumen and moral fortitude, Lincoln pushes forward to compel the nation, and those in government who oppose him, to aim toward a greater good for all mankind. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Curly Top
fxm.us.description: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary. (Musical) - 1935

fxm.us.title: Wee Willie Winkie
fxm.us.description: With her widowed mother (June Lang), precocious Priscilla (Shirley Temple) travels to India to live with her grandfather, Col. Williams (C. Aubrey Smith). A stern officer in the British army, the colonel makes it clear that a military garrison isn't any place for a child. Priscilla proves otherwise, befriending tenderhearted Sgt. MacDuff (Victor McLaglen), getting caught up in the plot of a rebel leader (Cesar Romero) and charming everyone in sight. (Comedy drama) - 1937

fxm.us.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
fxm.us.description: After Rebecca (Shirley Temple) is mistakenly rejected at an audition for a radio advertising campaign, her stepfather takes her upstate to stay at Sunnybrook Farm with her Aunt Miranda (Helen Westley), who bans her from show business. Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart). (Musical) - 1938

fxm.us.title: The Three Musketeers
fxm.us.description: In this musical comedy version of Alexandre Dumas' timeless novel, D'Artagnan (Don Ameche), a French peasant with dreams of joining the Musketeers, sets out for Paris. On the road, he comes across the three warriors. Athos (Douglas Dumbrille) challenges D'Artagnan to a duel, but eventually all four become fast friends. The Musketeers make an ally of the Queen of France (Gloria Stuart) and find themselves constantly dueling with the wicked Milady De Winter (Binnie Barnes). (Musical comedy) - 1939

fxm.us.title: The Black Swan
fxm.us.description: With the pardon of notorious pirate Henry Morgan by the English King, Caribbean pirates are offered amnesty if they give up their lawless ways. As governor of Jamaica, Morgan picks Captain Jamie Waring to round up the renegade captain Billy Leech. Beautiful Margaret Denby complicates matters for Waring, as her scorn for him is matched only by his love for her. (Adventure) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
fxm.us.description: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity. (Science fiction) - 1961

fxm.us.title: The French Dispatch
fxm.us.description: A love letter to journalists set in an outpost of an American newspaper in a fictional 20th-century French city that brings to life a collection of stories published in "The French Dispatch." (Comedy drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021
