5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff). (Drama) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
5starmax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
5starmax.us.description: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm. (Musical comedy) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: The Daytrippers
5starmax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. - 2007

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society. - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents. - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Volunteers
5starmax.us.description: An Ivy Leaguer (Tom Hanks) avoids his bookie by going with the Peace Corps to build a bridge in 1962 Thailand. - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Hoot
5starmax.us.description: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls. - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: With the sitter dead, a Los Angeles teen (Christina Applegate) lands a job in the fashion industry to feed her siblings. - 1991

bbcamerica.us.description: Paul Edgecomb walks the mile with a variety of cons. Beyond his simple, naive nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Cambodia and Vietnam Rick enjoys freshly caught swimmer crabs cooked with green peppercorns.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

(Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-01-22

cinevault.us.title: Anaconda

Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997-07-11

Despite the villagers' wariness of Yanko, Amy cultivates a relationship with him, while Miss Swaffer's doctor, James (Ian McKellen), teaches him English. When Amy marries Yanko, despite the objections of James -- who secretly pines for the sailor -- tragedy lurks around the corner. (Movie, Romance) - 1997

cinevault.us.title: Swept Away

cinevault.us.title: Straw Dogs
cinevault.us.description: Married couple David (James Marsden) and Amy (Kate Bosworth) move to her hometown of Blackwater, Miss., after her father's death. They have a plan to renovate Amy's old home and prepare it for sale while David works on his latest screenplay. However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

cinevault.us.title: All the King's Men
cinevault.us.description: Charismatic Southern politician Willie Stark's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana. Unfortunately for Stark, his right-hand man (Jude Law) retains the same good moral fiber he had when the men both entered the political arena. (Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-22

cinevault.us.title: Awakenings
cinevault.us.description: The story of a doctor's extraordinary work in the Sixties with a group of catatonic patients he finds languishing in a Bronx hospital. Speculating that their rigidity may be akin to an extreme form of Parkinsonism, he seeks permission from his skeptical superiors to treat them with L-dopa, a drug that was used to treat Parkinson's disease at the time. (Biography, Drama, Movie) - 1990-12-20

cinevault.us.title: White Boy Rick
cinevault.us.description: Rick Wershe is a single father who's struggling to raise two teenagers during the height of the crack epidemic in the 1980s Detroit. Wershe sells guns illegally to make ends meet but soon attracts attention from the FBI. Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself. (Biography, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-08-31

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Smoke and Mirrors
dateline.us.description: When a Chicago woman from a big family goes missing, investigators begin to suspect a man in her life is full of secrets.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Secrets From the Grave
dateline.us.description: A man calls 911 to report that his pregnant wife has died by suicide; the case is closed until a suspicious house fire 24 years later leads police to question what really happened that day.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Face of Evil
dateline.us.description: As detectives struggle to find leads in the murder of a college student, the perpetrator strikes again.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Devil Was Watching
dateline.us.description: When Tina Sandoval disappears, her parents and loved ones spend years searching for her; a secret she was keeping may lead to clues about what happened to her.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Black Widow of Lomita
dateline.us.description: A California woman's two former husbands are mysteriously murdered, nearly 20 years apart.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deliberate Evil
dateline.us.description: A woman is found murdered after her close friend hears her screaming on the phone; the mysterious death of her boyfriend's twin brother leads investigators to a suspect.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Breakup
dateline.us.description: A nurse is gunned down in her home and detectives believe they have a clear suspect; as they delve deeper into the investigation new information leads them down a completely different path.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Root of All Evil
dateline.us.description: After a young father is found dead in his home in Jonesboro, Ark., the authorities search for the killer.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Ultimate Betrayal
dateline.us.description: After Tahereh Ghassemi disappears from the Louisiana home she shares with her adult son, detectives discover that she'd recently come into a great deal of money; the investigation reveals an astonishing plot with international implications.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The End of the Affair
dateline.us.description: After police discover the burned body of a missing Miami man at the edge of the Florida Everglades, the wife of a local supermarket mogul comes forward to reveal a shocking secret and possible lead.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Under the Desert Sky
dateline.us.description: A teen's murder shakes a Nevada community, especially when two unlikely people make confessions.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Man Who Wasn't There
dateline.us.description: Intruders break into a family's home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Phone Call
dateline.us.description: Kathleen Schroll makes a phone call right before her death where she identifies her killer, which leads to an arrest. Two trials and 12 years later, authorities begin to wonder who was really the victim.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - House of Secrets
dateline.us.description: A community is left in shock when a Cornell student and star athlete gets caught in the middle of a homicide investigation.

dateline.us.description: After filming wraps on an indie horror movie, the cast members learn their lead actress is not who she says she is and has been charged with killing her uncle.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deadly Exchange
dateline.us.description: A foreign exchange student and soccer player's participation in a dangerous game leads to deadly consequences.

dateline.us.description: Police investigate when the seemingly storybook romance between a football player and the homecoming queen ends in a death.

dateline.us.description: The investigation into the death of a woman whose remains were found in her Frisco, Texas, garage leads detectives to a series of suspects with connections to the victim's complicated and secretive life.

dateline.us.description: A man is shot and killed while picking up his daughter for a court-ordered visit.

dateline.us.description: An Air Force captain is shot dead leaving police to suspect his wife and her Army sharpshooter lover.

dateline.us.description: The investigation into the death of a Florida firefighter reveals a tale of secrets, lies and infidelity.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Return to the Early Shift
dateline.us.description: A Kentucky man is convicted of murdering his co-worker; the mystery is considered solved until a stunning disclosure years later turns the closed case upside down.

dateline.us.description: A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.

dateline.us.description: The mystery of a successful real estate entrepreneur killed by a car bomb spans nearly two decades.

dateline.us.description: A tale of sex, betrayal and murder: Inside the deadly love triangle where three became a crowd.

dateline.us.description: The trial and murder conviction of Jodi Arias and the salacious relationship that ended in tragedy.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Without a Trace
dateline.us.description: A 29-year-old woman goes missing.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Feud
dateline.us.description: A man dies in a shooting incident after tempers flare in a confrontation in Montana's Glacier National Park.

dateline.us.description: The family members of murdered California entrepreneur Chris Smith speak out; interviews with investigators, Smith's former colleague, and prosecutor Matt Murphy.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Call
dateline.us.description: A dancer is murdered in her Virginia home; after interviewing a series of suspects, detectives realize the case is much more complicated than previously thought.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Twisted
dateline.us.description: When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Case of the Missing D.A
dateline.us.description: Lester Holt reports on the mysterious 2005 disappearance of Ray Gricar, a district attorney in Pennsylvania who investigated sex-abuse claims made against Jerry Sandusky in 1998.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Missing Marie
dateline.us.description: The investigation into a newlywed's disappearance focuses on her job as a CIA employee as a possible clue.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Last Weekend
dateline.us.description: After trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a scheduled gig, his family learns his body was abandoned in the remote Colorado Rockies; as the investigation narrows in on two suspects, a second murder catches police by surprise.

dateline.us.description: A small Ohio town is left in shock after a local coal miner is found fatally shot in the basement of his home; As investigators dig into his personal life, a secret affair reveals a surprising suspect.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E01 "Fifth Gear" quite literally takes to new heights by staging a race between cars and planes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E02 Tom Ford is testing the opulent £225,000 Bentley Azure with some help from film director Michael Winner; Jonny Smith tries to drive coast-to-coast using chip fat as fuel.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E05 Jason drives the impressive 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500; Tiff races Mitsubishi's Evo 9 FQ360 against a former Red Arrow pilot's stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the big lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E10 Tom Ford's been testing the Mazda's new MX5 Roadster Coupe; Vicki Butler-Henderson has been thrashing Porsche's 911 GT3.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E13 The winners of the Fifth Gear Awards 2006; prizes for Best Small Car, Best Family Car, Best Fast Car and the overall Car of the Year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (Action, Drama, War) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings. (Action, Thriller) - 2008

Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend

One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way

Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers

Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman

thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E10 Weston: Bringing Things Together On the roof at the project house in Weston, plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey shows Kevin O'Connor the new solar hot water system, perfect for the cold climate; tile contractor Mark Ferrante preps a shower stall for tile.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E11 Weston: Making A Mark At the project house in Weston; Jeff Wolfe is installing solar panels; a prefabricated Habitat for Humanity house that volunteers assembled in 8 days; red distressed vertical boards; custom half-round copper gutters and decorative brackets.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E12 Weston: Natural Surfaces and the Latest Appliances Installing granite steps on the entry porch and flooring on the first floor; test-driving new appliances before buying them; installing a cure for the cell phone dead zone; a few unexpected options for furnishing a timber frame home.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E13 Weston: Keeping it Green Outside A local non-profit farm stand; general contractor Tom Silva puts down composite decking; how the town of Weston is working towards sustainable harvest trees for its residents to use; a neutral paint color palette is selected for the second floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E14 Weston: LEED Requirements Learning more about the LEED for Homes program and how the Weston house will qualify; how they build window trim kits in the Bensonwood shop and how they are installed at the project house; the new industrial steel staircase.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E15 Weston: Amy Lends a Hand Roger installs a berm and fence; Wes Wirth and Amy review the native plants they've chosen; Richard shows Kevin how the house is being cooled with a split-type air conditioning system; Tom Silva installs a handcrafted copper owl weathervane.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E16 Weston: The Weston Timberframe Complete Completing landscaping work; reviewing how the choices of lighting, hardware and wood finishes contribute to the barn effect; finishing the security system and industrial light fixtures; a signature table for dining room; touring the finished job.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E17 New York City: A TOH Brownstone In Brooklyn Kevin O'Connor and Norm Abram restore a neglected 1904 brownstone in Brooklyn; converting the former rooming house into a three family home while preserving and restoring period detail wherever possible.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E18 New York City: Classic New York A visit to Prospect Park; Norm meets Michael R. Streaman and Karen Shen to check framing progress and kitchen layout; Richard meets with contractors for options on the old heating system; Roger visits a garden center and a roof garden in Tribeca.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E19 New York City: Preservation & Planning Norm meets local refinisher John Thomas for an assessment of the wood finishes in the house and how to properly restore them; some period-appropriate tile combinations for the bathrooms and kitchen; converting the old steam radiators to hot water.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E20 New York City: In With the New Inspecting the new exterior paint job; white oak flooring is laid down in the parlor with two decorative accent strips of cherry; plaster crown moldings are replicated; the progress on a new retaining wall; the brick patio; new replacement windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E21 New York City: Making it Their Own Checking the progress in the owner's unit as the new white oak flooring is installed; the showerhead combination that includes a master showerhead, a handheld showerhead and tub filler; the paint color scheme for the first floor; a new privacy fence.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S30 E22 New York City: Restoring and Replacing Installing vintage spiral stairs; the new plaster medallion is installed in the parlor; laying down click-together linoleum floor tiles; Norm Abram sees how the original five panel interior doors are rehabilitated.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

outlaw.us.title: Tall in the Saddle
outlaw.us.description: Cowboy Rocklin rides into a dusty western township where he's been promised work on a ranch. But when he finds that his future boss has been gunned down, he's forced to find work elsewhere. Despite his sexist attitudes, Rocklin charms the fiery Arly with his cavalier bravado and lands a job at her family's ranch. There, however, he learns that Judge Garvey was involved in his original employer's murder and is now trying to steal the dead man's land. (Western) - 1944

outlaw.us.title: She Wore a Yellow Ribbon
outlaw.us.description: The last job of Calvary Captain Nathan Brittles (John Wayne) before retirement is to soothe relations with the Cheyenne and Arapaho Indians after Custer's last stand. At the same time, he must transport the wife (Mildred Natwick) and niece (Joanne Dru) of his commanding officer to a safe destination. After both his missions stall, Brittles attempts a face-to-face meeting with an important Native American chief in order to stave off an impending war. (Western, Adventure) - 1949

outlaw.us.title: Wichita
outlaw.us.description: After a group of drunken trail riders runs amok, Mayor Andrew Hope (Carl Benton Reid) of Wichita, Kan., recruits the intrepid Wyatt Earp (Joel McCrea) to end lawlessness. Armed and ready for anything, the new marshal decides he will end gun violence simply by banning guns. Soon Earp must face crooked rancher Clint Wallace (Walter Sande) and whiskey slinger Doc Black (Edgar Buchanan), vicious locals who like Wichita exactly as it is and don't take kindly to being told what to do. (Western) - 1955

outlaw.us.title: The Virginian
outlaw.us.description: Determined to carve out a life on the new frontier, the Virginian (Bill Pullman) heads west to Wyoming. He signs on as foreman of a cattle ranch and begins romancing Molly Stark (Diane Lane), a quiet but pretty schoolteacher who's also from the east. An old rivalry rears its head in the form of Trampas (Colm Feore), a former friend who betrayed the Virginian. Another rancher begins a feud, and the Virginian must defend his honor while still hoping to gain Molly's approval. (Western) - 2000

outlaw.us.title: Nevada Smith
outlaw.us.description: Part-Indian gunslinger Nevada (Cliff Potts) delivers explosives with his partner, Jonas Cord (Lorne Greene). (Western) - 1975

outlaw.us.title: Kung Fu: The Movie
outlaw.us.description: Searching for a peaceful life in 1885 Sacramento, Calif., Caine is stalked by opium traders and a vengeful Manchu lord. (Western) - 1986

outlaw.us.title: Arrow in the Dust
outlaw.us.description: A cavalry deserter (Sterling Hayden) poses as a major and leads a wagon train with a hidden cargo of repeating rifles. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Mail Order Bride
outlaw.us.description: In late-19th-century Montana, Will Lane (Buddy Ebsen) is sent to look after unruly Lee (Keir Dullea), the son of a deceased pal. Lane hopes to find Lee a bride who'll tame him, so he selects a mail-order wife, Annie (Lois Nettleton). All goes according to plan, until carefree bachelor Lee makes a deal with Annie: he'll support her financially if she leaves him after the wedding. Annie agrees, but when Lee truly falls for his bride-to-be, he must choose between his lawless ways and settling down. (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: 3 Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: Thieves and rustlers Robert Hightower (John Wayne), Pete Fuerte (Pedro Armendáriz) and the Abilene Kid (Harry Carey Jr.) rob a bank in a small Arizona town. Pursued across the desert by the indefatigable Sheriff Buck Sweet (Ward Bond), the trio lose their horses, suffer injuries, and come across a stranded woman (Mildred Natwick) who is dying while giving birth. Promising to carry the woman's newborn to safety, the repentant criminals struggle to reach the village of New Jerusalem. (Western) - 1948

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne
outtvproud.us.description: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task. (Fantasy, Horror, Adventure, Action) - 2005

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward). (Horror, Western, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
outtvproud.us.description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal. (Action, Horror) - 2010

outtvproud.us.title: Jeffrey
outtvproud.us.description: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance. (Comedy) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: Flight 7500
outtvproud.us.description: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

outtvproud.us.title: Down a Dark Hall
outtvproud.us.description: Five emotionally fragile teens are committed to Blackwood, a mysterious school for gifted girls. Mesmerized by the intense head mistress Madame Duret, they think they have found a place where they can finally flourish academically and artistically. The mystery deepens as they break through layer after layer of misdirection to discover the true, horrifying purpose of the school. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

outtvproud.us.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
outtvproud.us.description: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret. (Horror, Thriller) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: Taboo

outtvproud.us.title: But I'm a Cheerleader
outtvproud.us.description: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham. (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 1999

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E16 Property Brothers: George & Jenn In order to cut down on his monster commute, George and Jenn want to move closer to family and friends. And while that's something they both agree on, they're miles apart when it comes to design.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E08 Property Brothers: Nathan & Jessica Tennis pros Jessica and Nathan have been living a cramped condo lifestyle for way too long. And now they're desperate to find a sprawling home in the country where they can put down roots and entertain family in style.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E23 Property Brothers: Kristin & Kacy Kristin recently packed up her busy life and moved to the city of her dreams, and now the search is on for a cozy and eclectic Nashville pad that's big enough for a new dog and her best friend from back home, Kacy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E18 Property Brothers: Marc & Stephanie Stephanie and Marc are getting frustrated with their house hunt. They've been outbid on a series of properties in the city, and the Property Brothers try to sell them on a radically different approach.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E09 Property Brothers: Mark & Eugenie Juggling after-school activities with their careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had time for house hunting. While the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, the Property Brothers warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E21 Property Brothers - Tom & TJ Tom and TJ moved to Nashville to pursue a dream job, but they haven't yet put down roots and are cramped into a friend's studio apartment until they do.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 A Pop of Color Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Every Woman's Dream Home Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Builder Basic to Modern Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 New Generation Style Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Fire Kings
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
tastemadetravel.us.description: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens. (Cooking) - 2025-10-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Welcome to Guadalajara
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Jalisco Style Birria
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Double Vallarta
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Thierry Blouet offers a tour of Puerto Vallarta's street food; La Docena restaurant; the ins and outs of one of Nuevo Vallarta's biggest resort destinations. (Cooking) - 2021-11-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tacos and a Tostada
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover. (Cooking)

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Labná
truehistory.us.description: Labna is an architectural wonder crowned by three buildings, which are the Palacio, the El Mirador pyramid and the Labna Arch; decoding the cultural messages in these famous works; traveling back to Merida. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Discoveries and Their Significance
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the Dead Sea Scrolls and their discovery; ancient Judaism and early Christianity prior to the scrolls; the uncovering of the scrolls and how they alter one's understanding of every aspect of the historical period of their creation. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The First Seven Scrolls
truehistory.us.description: Diving into a tale of excitement and adventure and discovering more about how scholars gain access to the first seven scrolls discovered at Qumran; what they find when they begin to translate the extraordinary initial discoveries. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - Opening and Reading the First Scroll
truehistory.us.description: Immersing into the text of the scrolls, starting with the scroll known as the Community Rule or Manual of Discipline; the important text that gives one the first insight into the community and theology of the scrolls' creators and guardians. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Historical Backdrop of Ancient Judaism
truehistory.us.description: Examining history prior to the scrolls, beginning with the biblical period and moving to the Maccabean revolt; the arrival of the Romans; King Herod's reign; the life of Jesus; the Zealot revolt; the destruction of Jerusalem and the fall of Masada. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Rise of the Jewish Sects
truehistory.us.description: Jewish sectarianism in late antiquity; focusing on the Sadducees, Pharisees, Essenes and Zealots through Josephus, the Jewish philosopher Philo and the authors of the New Testament books; the later rabbis; Roman polymath Pliny the Elder. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Dead Sea Site of the Qumran Sect
truehistory.us.description: Visiting the isolated region of Qumran's caves; learning how archeological excavations of a nearby ruin help scholars form the most accepted hypothesis of who writes the scrolls and why the scrolls are deposited in the caves. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - The Emergence of the Rabbinic System
truehistory.us.description: Stepping forward in time and examining some later rabbinic texts from the third century; the rise of the rabbinical tradition; vital perspectives on the composition of the Dead Sea Scrolls. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls - A Dead Sea Scroll from Medieval Cairo
truehistory.us.description: Two copies of the Damascus Document are discovered in a Cairo synagogue in the 1890s; although the copies are medieval, the texts are believed to be ancient, a conclusion later confirmed when fragments of the same texts are found at Qumran. (Educational, Religious) - 2010-03-05

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Mérida
truehistory.us.description: A trip to Mérida, the capital of the Yucatán; visiting a factory hosting the revival of an industry that made the Yucatán rich more than 100 years ago; the mansions lining Mérida's Paseo de Mont; shopping for the perfect hammock and guayabera shirt. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Chichén Itzá
truehistory.us.description: Traveling to Izamal, the "yellow city" named after the Maya sky god; touring the city's history, including a walk through the Convent of St. Anthony of Padua; venturing to Chichen Itza; looking at the achievements of Maya architecture. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Ek' Balam
truehistory.us.description: A trip to Valladolid and Ek' Balam, two places in the Yucatan; the first offers travelers a chance to see a traditional agave distillery and an all-female troop of competitive horseback riders; the second is the ruins of what was once a Maya capital. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Tihosuco
truehistory.us.description: Accompanying Dr. Barnhart as he writes his name in Maya hieroglyphs; talking to howler monkeys; plunging into a geological cathedral; a journey to Tihosuco, home to an episode of an oppressed people fighting for their independence. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Mayapán
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the history and culture of Mayapan and its surrounding region; the destruction of sacred Maya codices during public acts of faith held by the Spanish friar Diego de Landa; sampling dishes of grilled pork and ground pumpkin seeds. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Uxmal
truehistory.us.description: Discovering what makes Uxmal a marvel of Maya urban planning; Dr. Barnhart explores archeological features, including the Pyramid of the Dwarf, the Palace of the Governors and the Nunnery Quadrangle; exploring the Loltun Caves. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

truehistory.us.title: Exploring the Mayan World - Celestún
truehistory.us.description: Looking at Kabah, where one will find over 200 faces of Chaac the rain god and a rare example of literate public art; visiting Becal, famous for producing some of the best jipijapas in the Yucatán; taking a trip to the Celestun biosphere. (Travel) - 2020-07-17

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Patchwork Quilt
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bedtime Story
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Olden Days
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Sleepy Princess
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is bedtime, and to help Peppa and George go to sleep, Daddy Pig tells them the story of "The Sleepy Princess. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Library
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sailing Boat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George sailing, but they keep getting stuck in the mud. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Fox's Van
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mysteries
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun playing detectives. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Soft Play
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited, and that can only mean one thing; Soft Play. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Kylie Kangaroo
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pedro is Late
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The playgroup is going on a trip to the museum. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The School Fete
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loves the school fete. Her favourite things are face painting, the balloons and the bouncy castle. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mummy Pig's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George and Daddy Pig prepare a wonderful birthday surprise for Mummy Pig. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Talent Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is Talent Day at Peppa's playgroup, and Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Police Station
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Oh, no! George has lost Mr. Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mummy Rabbit's Bump
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pirate Island
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends find buried treasure, and a shopping trolley, on their exciting trip to Pirate Island. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caves
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The family has all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Taxi
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping off, but that's not the last trip of the day for her. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Doll Hospital
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Peppa gets Teddy dirty jumping in muddy puddles, she goes to The Doll Hospital. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Boat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and today Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them. Danny Dog and Granddad Dog are there as well. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - School Project
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's school project time for Peppa and her friends which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hospital
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Pedro Pony is in hospital with a broken leg! The class come to see him. Pedro is being well looked-after - there's always someone to scratch behind your ears. And soon his leg is all better. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Tiny Land
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Recycling
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family have a fun day out at the Recycling Centre. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Baby
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004
