sbsbrisbane.au.title: Paul O'Grady For The Love Of Dogs
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Paul O'Grady meets Florence, a pug-terrier cross who's been badly injured in a car accident. While out helping with her rehabilitation, Paul bumps into Jennifer Saunders. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Paul O'Grady For The Love Of Dogs
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Paul O'Grady gets into full protective clothing to meet Humphrey, an 11 week old Beddlington Terrier who is suffering from ringworm. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Our Welsh Chapel Dream
sbsbrisbane.au.description: With the chapel being unliveable for many more months, Keith and Marj have come up with a radical idea to sleep on site a lot sooner. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Susan Calman's Grand Week By The Sea
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Susan Calman visits Clacton-on-Sea, exploring its famous pier, beach, theatre and seaside attractions. Along the way she makes candy floss, meets Nina Wadia and enjoys classic coastal fun. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: BBC News At Ten
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: France 24 International SBS Midday
sbsbrisbane.au.description: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Compass Points from PBS News
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Join PBS News Hour's Nick Schifrin and leading experts as they analyse prominent international affairs topics and their impact on America today. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Al Jazeera News Second Edition
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In-depth global news from Al Jazeera Satellite Network, Doha, Qatar, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Every Family Has a Secret
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Koori woman Paula Morrison traces the difficult life of her tormented Austrian-born father, uncovering disturbing allegiances to the Nazi party within her family's European history. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Robson Green's Weekend Escapes
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Robson is joined by his footballing hero, Shola Ameobi - a former striker with Newcastle United. The roadtrip to Beadnell is the perfect setting for an intimate chat about the player's childhood. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsbrisbane.au.description: You say tomato, Adam says tomato party. On the guest list: chef Shane Delia, Paralympic gold and silver medallist Vanessa Low OAM, and you! (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Dinosaur With Stephen Fry - Struggle To Survive, The
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Stephen Fry heads 66 million years into the past, to the fateful last days of the dinosaurs, to see how plant-eaters fought back against predators like the deadly T-Rex. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Jeopardy!
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Letters And Numbers - Letters And Numbers Series 5 Ep 77
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Two contestants pit their linguistic and numerical skills against each other and the clock in this entertaining quiz show. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Mastermind Australia
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In this round, the specialty subjects are NSW Road Rules, Voyager 1 and 2, The Works of Stanley Kubrick, and Sydney FC 2004-Present. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News - Sbs World News 2026 Ep 306
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Big Fat Quiz: Best Bits
sbsbrisbane.au.description: An incredible line-up of guests, including Harry Hill, Michael McIntyre and Fatiha El-Ghorri, turns on host Jimmy Carr in some of the funniest rebellious moments from The Big Fat Quiz. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: 24 Hours In Emergency
sbsbrisbane.au.description: 29 year old James is rushed to Queen's Medical Centre after crashing his motorbike into a road sign. A second motorcyclist, Peter, is air lifted to hospital after crashing at high speed. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: 8 Out Of 10 Cats Does Countdown - 8 Out Of 10 Cats Does Countdown Series 14 Ep 11
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Join host Jimmy Carr for season fourteen of 8 Out Of 10 Cats. Lee Mack and Jason Manford take on Jon Richardson and Sarah Millican. Nick Mohammed as Mr Swallow joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News Late
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Icebreaker - Nightsider
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The survivors camp at Burnhill island. To Sanna s horror, she witnesses a vision that shouldn t be possible. Sanna realizes that she has a deeper connection to the mysterious events than she realizes. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Icebreaker - Final Day
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Sanna uncovers the truth about her father's disappearance and its link to the icebreaker crew. As tensions reach breaking point, she faces a final reckoning that will determine who survives. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Prisoner - Is There Bad News?
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The information from Sammi's secret source leads to more successful raids, which impresses the consultants but puts the inmates under pressure and makes them desperate as their business is ruined. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Prisoner - Can I Get A Cough?
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Sammi and Ariana are getting closer although she seemed like a difficult and annoying roommate at first. Gert must take a difficult and heartbreaking decision. (Drama)

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E10 Fearne Cotton Prue is joined in her Cotswold Kitchen by Fearne Cotton.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E1 Tastes Of Tuscany Mary commemorates her recent travels by creating tasty dishes inspired by Italy, like apple raspberry crostata and mushroom crespelle.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E21 My Goats & Ricotta Lidia grew up around goats, and their delicious milk which were used to make ricotta. She makes spinach ricotta dumplings, an open cookie cannoli, and then ricotta meatloaf with tomato sauce.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E5 Australia Australia has developed an enviable reputation for its very efficient pasture based dairy system and significant exports of cheddar, butter, and skimmed milk.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E1 Kruger Safari Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E6 Nice Our journey heads to Nice the vibrant capital of the French Riviera. For this special day, Luana has designed an itinerary full of surprises, where tradition meets creativity.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Lund, Sweden In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year-old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E3 Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E12 Cooking With Grapes Raise a toast to the glorious grape as Simon and Maggie celebrate with the fruit of the vine.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E26 Episode 26 Laura makes her delicious Spinach and Feta Rolls in the heart of the Prahran Market. In the Yarra Valley, Charlie Carrington cooks Chicken Enchiladas.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E26 Pesto 2.0 Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a Pesto alla Trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Clontarf Clontarf Reserve is the perfect spot for a BBQ, and Hayden turns things up a notch with recipes featuring beef steaks, lamb cutlets and a pork loin rack.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E4 Wendell Pierce Award-winning actor and producer Wendell Pierce is joining Ina for cooking and conversation at the barn.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E21 Episode 21 Laura starts the show in the historic Prahran Market making a simple and heart-warming Potato and Leek Soup.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Featuring Matt Keenan, Gary brings together fresh, lively flavours in a menu of poke bowl with salmon, cucumber salad, and a Greek style fetta and greens pie served with Yemeni sauce.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E50 Episode 50 Spicy Prawn Tacos and a way to tame those spices with a special visit from Thomas Schnetzler from Lindt who makes a decadent Chocolate Truffle Cake.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S8 E83 Bang For Your Buck Prepare to taste the savings as Adam, musician Sarah McLeod and chef Grant King give you bang for your buck!

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Justine has big plans for a mountaintop picnic-but the Norwegian weather has other ideas. She takes shelter in a mountain hut instead, where she puts together a beautiful spread of open sandwiches.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Feast By Fire
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E6 Rice And Peaches Chef Tom Kerridge's journey takes him to Catalonia in his bespoke vintage food truck as he heads to the Ebro Delta, where rice fields cover the landscape.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Poh Cooks Malaysia
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 After 13 years away, Poh returns to Kuala Lumpur to rediscover the flavours that shaped her. From the historic streets of Kampung Baru to a traditional family home and a buzzing wet market.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E11 Foods That Makes You Manly After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E12 Eating On The Edge Of Nowhere Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on Earth.
